# KashFlow workspace instructions

- This workspace is a React + TypeScript + Vite application.
- Keep the product Kenyan-first, use KSh for financial UI, and clearly distinguish demo data from real integrations.
- Do not imply that KRA/eTIMS, SHIF, NSSF, Affordable Housing Levy, bank, or M-Pesa connections are live unless an approved provider integration is actually implemented and configured.
- Treat payroll and tax computations as versioned, testable domain logic and require qualified review before production use.
- Preserve responsive layouts, accessible labels, and clear status feedback when changing the UI.
